sibilant consonant.d: a consonant characterized by a hissing sound (like s or sh)

siberia.d: a vast Asian region of Russia; famous for long cold winters

sibine.d: a Chadic language spoken in Chad

sibyl.d: a woman who was regarded as an oracle or prophet

sib.d: one related by blood or origin; especially on sharing an ancestor with another

sibylline.d: having a secret or hidden meaning

sibilant.d: of speech sounds produced by forcing air through a constricted passage (as “f”, “s”, “z”, or “th” in both “thin” and “then”)

sibilation.d: a fricative sound (especially as an expression of disapproval)

sibilate.d: make a sharp hissing sound, as if to show disapproval

sibyllic.d: resembling or characteristic of a prophet or prophecy
